reviews.text: It's now my trusted clinic. Everyone is very thorough and empathetic. We were treated by Dr. Giulia (who was excellent)! Even my dog ​​Ara approves!
Extremely competent staff. They solved my problem with professionalism and great humanity!

Roberta Bonalumi is an excellent veterinarian. Always attentive and caring.
I highly recommend her.
Cristiano Bellarosa

Last October, we met Dr. Bonalumi, who remains a true angel to me because she immediately understood what was wrong with our setter. With extreme sensitivity and dedication, she saved
our dog, accompanying us through the
treatment process like
holding a child by the hand. She reassured us, was clear, precise, and super professional. The clinic is on the
other side of Milan, but it doesn't matter; now I finally know I'm in good
hands. I could tell you this and much more... I know
Except that when we have a question, we always find the
right answer. Love breathes in the clinic. 🧡 Thank you, Barbara.
Excellent clinic, and exceptional staff

I called to find out how much a diagnosis and treatment would cost for my dog, who was bleeding after eating a bone.
They told me they didn't know, but it should be around €250, max €300.
I went to the clinic and, after a thorough examination, he went to give me a quote and discovered it was a whopping €410.
The price included:
€80 consultation
€80 x-ray
€200 blood tests
€50 symptomatic treatment.
I refused the blood tests and accepted the x-ray.
After a few minutes, he came back saying he couldn't see where the bone was and that the dog had colitis, but that without the blood tests he couldn't give me a treatment.
When I paid €160 for a visit and a useless x-ray, he also wanted me to sign a waiver of liability document informing me that the animal was in serious health conditions, but without even mentioning it verbally. I decided not to sign because he hadn't even mentioned that the dog would need to be hospitalized.
It gave me the impression that he just wanted to wash his hands of the matter after taking the money and without giving anything in return.
I strongly advise against it.

I'm the mother of two dogs, and the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic is a guarantee for me. I've always found professionalism, helpfulness, and a lot of love there. Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has always looked after us, and with her skill, she's always found a solution to all our problems. She's always been available, even just for advice, becoming part of the family for us, and we all, including our furry friends, respect and love her immensely. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is a professional, competent, and very helpful veterinarian. Whenever I've needed help for my dog, she's been prompt and attentive. She's become a go-to person for me, always supporting me and taking great care of my four-legged friend. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a reliable veterinarian who's passionate about her work.

Everyone was so kind to me, but Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is truly special! After the loss of my Gedeone, I didn't want any more animals, but if I have Dolby now, it's only because I know I can count on her, always!!!! Thank you for existing, wonderful and unique Doctor ❤️

Good morning
I'm writing on August 3rd in a scorching, deserted Milan to thank all the staff at the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic. Thanks to their experience and professionalism, they rescued my two-year-old cat, who was terribly frightened by a hairball and feces blockage. They treated her with kindness, and from now on I will adopt them, because it's easy to be good when you have to get a vaccination or when all the vets are present and not on vacation. Thank you all for what you've done for my little Nayla and for us.
Paola

Clinic once cutting edge but sad to say it has gotten worse.. little attention to the animal goes in the evening and they huff and puff because they have had a hard day and are tired... if one goes it is because it is urgent / certainly not to pass the time instead it seems like you are bothering them and they tell you to come back tomorrow when perhaps the situation gets worse... wrong diagnoses wrong therapies sometimes it happened that I had to tell my pet the therapies to give otherwise they didn't even know how to move only complain... never again... unfortunately, due to an incorrect diagnosis, a friend caused her dog to die... vets who do not know the therapies that were administered the day before to the dog and cat by the previous colleague on duty... they don't even give you a list of the medications administered!! I'm sorry to say it but it's the truth... lastly years ago I had my little dog put in by them, paying for a microchip. and I only discovered a few weeks ago that the ASL of Milan passed away, it had not even been registered in my name but was still listed under the former owner of Pordenone!!! Crazy this is the Lorenteggio clinic
Thank you so much Alessandra!

There aren't enough words to thank this clinic, but especially Dr. Giulia and Dr. Roberta. They literally saved the life of my Ellie, an 18-year-old cat who arrived in desperate condition with severe diabetic complications and an infection. From the first moment, I encountered immense professionalism, combined with rare empathy and kindness. They supported me step by step, explaining every detail of the treatment to me with infinite patience. Thanks to them, Ellie is purring again today, energetic, and full of life. You are angels, thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you've done.

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is excellent. She treats all furry friends as her own, so she treats them with professionalism and empathy. She can even handle anxious owners, which is no small feat! Well done, highly recommended, and deserving of your trust!

Roberta performed a surgery on my dog. She was so profeessional and reassuring. Everything went well. The clinique is a very empathic place. Not your average cold vet clinique. Its cosy and very humane. I would recommend it to everyone. Also I must add Roberta’s availability; everytime I have a stupid anxious question, I know that she will answer. Feel so lucky to have her as Fox’s vet!

I know Dr. Bonalumi because she cared for my first dog during the final years of his life. She is now the vet for my recently adopted Baldo. She has cared for him since his arrival, helping me improve his health (herlichia, various allergies, tracheitis, neutering, and all the necessary vaccinations). The doctor is my go-to person. Always reachable on WhatsApp, available, professional, and extremely humane and welcoming. I'm so happy to have found her on my journey with my dogs.

In the end, my cat died, and perhaps she would have died anyway. But if these people hadn't wasted so much of my time, perhaps I could have done more, or at least cared for her better and given her more time. I can't say everything I'd like to say and do everything I'd like to do to certain people to avoid getting into legal trouble. Any owner would be willing to spend a fortune to care for their kitten, who unfortunately can't speak. The veterinary system is rotten to the core and preys on people's emotions.

Excellent experience. I've been treated by Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for years. She's always available. She's truly dedicated to her work and loves animals as if they were her own. I'm grateful to have found someone so trustworthy.

Expertise, professionalism, and care, both for the animals and for us, the owners. I met Dr. Roberta Bonalumi after months of incorrect treatment for my dog's diabetes. In just a few weeks, she stabilized his condition with the correct treatment, making him feel better and reassuring us, thanks in part to her constant availability.
Highly recommended clinic!

The legendary Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has been taking care of our dogs for years now, and we've always found her to be not only good, but more! She's very helpful, excellent, thorough, and respectful. A very important point of reference for us! I recommend the clinic to everyone! 😀 …

Although it's not close to our home, the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic, and especially Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, are a safe and reliable point of reference. Our elderly dog ​​often needs care, but we can always count on the availability, assistance, and loving care of our favorite vet!

My thanks to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for the care, attention, and love she gives to my Gue' (dog) and my Leo (cat).
Extremely professional, but with an exceptional humanity that's hard to find!
My furry friends are always happy to see her, and I feel at peace whenever I have a problem or just a question to clarify.
Thank you!

We met Dr. Roberta Bonalumi (Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic) through a dear friend and cat lover. Since then, we've trusted her with our cats, especially Sirius, a problematic and sick cat, but Roberta always manages to treat him
with expertise, kindness, and great sensitivity. Thank you, Roberta.

Thank you so much for your helpfulness and professionalism, and the highly trained staff. A special thanks to Dr. Roberta, who is always available. I was particularly impressed by her dedication and care for each of her little guests. Thank you so much!
Dr. Bonalumi has been treating my dog ​​for several years. She's always available and loving with animals, very competent, knowledgeable about treatment technologies, and also very honest.
Very kind and always available! Dr. Roberta is fantastic! Extremely professional with unique attention.

The Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic is our go-to place for check-ups, tests, and visits for our cat. Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is highly competent, thorough, and empathetic, always available to answer questions and concerns. I believe trust in a veterinarian is essential for tackling everything well, and with her, we never feel alone. We're happy to have found such a welcoming place, where you can immediately sense the love and respect for animals.
Roberta is a top vet... along with all the other professionals at the clinic. I couldn't have found a better clinic ❤️
Always available for simple advice as well as for urgent and delicate interventions...true professionals. With 7 animals I couldn't find a better clinic.

I entrusted my dog ​​Olivia to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for spaying. The procedure went very well, but the most beautiful thing was the affection, love, and passion the doctor has always shown. Of course, she is my trusted veterinarian, always available to me and Olivia. Love, love, love.
Empathy, friendliness, and professionalism. Always available when needed. Roberta is a special veterinarian to whom I could confidently entrust my Mila!
Top always kind always ready! Very fair prices!

My dachshund is cared for by Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, and I can say I always feel in good hands. She's a kind, helpful, and very attentive professional, with a gentle and patient approach, even with my 4-month-old puppy. She inspires confidence and peace of mind every time we entrust ourselves to her.
Roberta Bonalumi is fantastic. Very kind, helpful, and super knowledgeable!!

Dr. Bonalumi is an excellent veterinarian: competent, empathetic, and very attentive to animal welfare. She treated our Leia when she suffered from severe hemorrhagic gastroenteritis. Thanks to her professionalism and ability to get to the bottom of the problem, she understood that it wasn't just a virus or infection, but a food intolerance.

She recommended a diet tailored to Leia's needs, and the improvements were immediately evident. In addition to her great professionalism, we appreciated her availability, sensitivity, and the sincere love she shows for our four-legged friends.

We are truly grateful for the care we received and highly recommend her to anyone looking for a reliable, dedicated, and passionate veterinarian. Thank you so much, Dr. Bonalumi! ❤️🐾

When I turned to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for my pets, the experience was excellent. I came to her after six months and several visits because my pitbull wasn't well and we couldn't figure out what was wrong. With professionalism, expertise, and a great sensitivity toward animals, evident from the first moment, the examination was thorough, explained clearly and without rushing, and she managed to save her life through surgery.
Furthermore, the environment is clean, organized, and welcoming, demonstrating care and availability. I really appreciated her ability to put both the animal and the owner at ease, patiently answering any questions. In short, an excellent service that inspires trust.
I recommend her to anyone looking for a serious, empathetic veterinarian who is truly passionate about her work. Even if the clinic isn't so close to my home, I wouldn't change it.
Terrible customer service, often rude and aggressive, especially the owner. There are many other, more professional clinics in Milan; here, it really depends on the day and their internal issues.

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has been caring for our dogs for several years, and we couldn't be more satisfied.

She cared for both our previous dog (Diky) and our current one (Paky), always demonstrating great professionalism, expertise, and passion for her work.

She is extremely conscientious, caring, and attentive to the well-being of animals, whom she treats with affection and respect.

Furthermore, she is always available to provide advice, clarifications, and appropriate consultations, making us feel supported in every situation—even the most critical ones. Knowing we can count on such a knowledgeable and compassionate veterinarian is truly reassuring.

We would recommend her without hesitation to anyone looking for a trustworthy professional for their four-legged friends!

The clinic provided excellent care for my pug, who underwent surgery in November 2025. The procedure was handled very well, including the anesthesia phase.
In particular, Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is a point of reference for my dog's health. Attentive, helpful, always available with precise instructions and prescriptions, and a passion for her work that is evident.
Efficient and very helpful staff. Dr. Roberta Bonalumi in particular is always very attentive and available for any emergency.

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is very good with dogs, always kind and helpful, very professional, and an excellent veterinarian!
Thank you, Robi
Good service, too expensive.
Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has been caring for our Paco for 8 years now. She's competent, thorough, fast, and affectionate with our pet. He always enjoys going there.

I've needed to visit this clinic several times for my dog, and I've always found them to be completely helpful and highly professional. Dr. Bonalumi, in particular, has a dedication to her patients that I've never seen elsewhere: in my case, she personally and meticulously followed Luna's entire recovery journey, always staying in touch by phone to monitor her progress. I highly recommend this facility to anyone seeking expertise and a truly unique human approach. Congratulations!

We frequent and recommend this veterinary clinic because it has our absolute favorite doctor, Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, who has cared for our furry friends since they were puppies. After all these years, we couldn't imagine another veterinarian for them.
Dr. Bonalumi is a competent, meticulous, and always available professional, but above all, she is a person who deeply loves animals. She treats them with kindness, care, and respect, and always manages to instill peace in us, too.
Knowing that our furry friends are in her care makes us feel calm and safe. That's why we continue to choose this clinic: because we have complete trust in her and the passion with which she does her work. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts, Dr. Roberta, for always being there for us.

My experience with Dr. Roberta Bonalumi was excellent even if it was not only linked to happy moments, indeed....but now who could ever be my Viggy's doctor if not Aunt Roby? I have full confidence in her professionalism.
Roberta is a cheerful, reliable, and serious professional. She's always available for a consultation, even over the phone, if you have any questions. Granello adores her, and so do I!

I have long-standing experience with the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic, known for working with Dr. Roberta Bonalumi. She is incredibly important to me and my furry friends. She's professional, but above all, she's dedicated to the animals she treats with love and kindness. When do you ever see a dog walking past the clinic wanting to come in and looking for her? I've seen it! Thank you so much to Dr. Roberta and all the staff.
Grazia Besia
A thousand thanks!

Five stars aren't enough to describe Dr. Roberta Bonalumi's professionalism and empathy. She's not only an extraordinary veterinarian, but also has a profound sensitivity towards our four-legged friends. She has treated my cat on multiple occasions, not always easy, with patience and thoroughness, always available and attentive. I highly recommend her!

I want to sincerely thank Dr. Roberta Bonalumi of the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic.

Dr. Bonalumi treated my cat Schizzo with exceptional professionalism and care. She's always available at any time, even for advice over the phone, and she never makes you go there "for nothing": she carefully assesses the situation first and intervenes only when truly necessary.

She's my trusted veterinarian, and I would recommend her to anyone with pets. You can tell right away that the pets' well-being comes first. The clinic is clean and organized. Highly recommended.

Thank you again, Dr., from Schizzo and Teresa 🐾

I've known the clinic for a long time and recently returned because my cat wasn't well; he was in serious trouble. Dr. Bonalumi immediately understood the problem and, without wasting time, intervened, resolving the issue in just a few days! Thank you ❤️ from the bottom of my heart! In addition to their expertise and professionalism, I always find helpfulness and humanity... and that's not to be taken for granted. They care about the well-being of our furry friends, and that makes all the difference. Thank you for everything!

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi of the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic is my lifesaver; she's a go-to person for me and my animals. She's available whenever we need her; she's patient, attentive, and incredibly talented. I recommend this clinic, and especially the doctor.
Martina

Ever since our furry friend has been with us, we've always relied on the Lorenteggio clinic... especially Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, who's always super efficient and reassuring, but above all, available for any problem!
Thanks to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for her courtesy, helpfulness, and professionalism.

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has been the veterinarian for my two dogs and a cat for five years now.
My family and I have always been very happy with her because she is a very helpful, thorough, and gentle professional with animals.
I recommend the Lorenteggio clinic to everyone!
I was fortunate enough to meet Dr. Roberta BONALUMI, who is very competent and empathetic with both my four-legged friends and me (who was very apprehensive). The best you can get, the TOP 🦮🦮😸😸 …

I had my dachshund spayed at this clinic, and I found them to be kind and competent.
Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is excellent, always attentive, available, and up-to-date.
Pepita and I have a wonderful doctor we trust!

Efficient clinic, moderate costs, excellent equipment and staff. A heartfelt thank you and sincere appreciation to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, who has been treating our cats for years. Her excellent medical technical professionalism, combined with her extensive multidisciplinary experience, as well as her passion, human sensitivity, and helpfulness, make her unique, reliable, and indispensable for our entire family (including our own cats!). Everyone—with all kinds of pets—to whom I've recommended Dr. Roberta has been thrilled!
Roberta Bonalumi is a veterinarian and a competent, professional person, but above all she is passionate about what she does, always kind and helpful.

My experience with Dr. Roberta Bonalumi over these six years has been absolutely positive. We love her professionalism, her dedication, her ability to be there for us in emergency situations, and we're happy she's with us in Tea's life.
We've always trusted Roberta Bonalumi, she's super professional and very kind! Even when we had emergencies, she didn't make us wait a single second.

One name: Robera Bonalumi, professional, knowledgeable, welcoming, and super helpful! A true rarity in a challenging environment (the veterinary one). Thank you, Roberta, for what you do every day for our beloved furry friends.

Professionalism, empathy, and infinite sweetness with our four-legged friend! Dr. Roberta Bonalumi cares for my dog ​​as if he were her own, always demonstrating great expertise, attention, and patience. She knows how to put him at ease, making the visit a peaceful experience. I couldn't entrust my dog ​​to better hands.
Thank you

Our primary veterinarian for several years now has been Dr. Roberta Bonalumi. Professional, competent, and always available, with a smile ready to put your mind at ease when needed.
Love for animals and great professionalism. Yes, our vet is different 😊
We have always found highly professional support accompanied, not to be taken for granted, by empathy and humanity. A special thanks to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi's professionalism, care, love, and patience are truly unique! Knowing that my cat is cared for by her and the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic if needed makes me feel at ease because he couldn't be in better hands!

Excellent clinic, I highly recommend Roberta Bonalumi, a very talented and helpful professional. She loves her
work and her patients: She always finds time for a checkup, even on short notice!! My dog ​​adores her and I have complete
trust in her!
A true guarantee and an irreplaceable point of reference! 💗

An extraordinary, all-round clinic. Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, in particular, is an extraordinary veterinarian. From our first meeting, she demonstrated great professionalism, expertise, and a genuine passion for her work. She cared for my pet with kindness, attention, and compassion, explaining everything clearly and always instilling peace of mind. She is a professional who is always available, meticulous, and capable of putting the animals' well-being first. Knowing I can count on someone so knowledgeable and attentive is truly reassuring. I recommend her without hesitation to anyone looking for a completely trustworthy veterinarian. Congratulations and thank you from the bottom of my heart!

Thanks to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, our children are receiving the best care possible!! After years, I can confirm that the certainty of continuous assistance in any emergency has never been lacking! We are so lucky to have her as our veterinarian.
I have known the clinic and Dr. Roberta for many years, a point of reference for Lombardy for their availability, availability and care in their work ❤️❤️
We had a great time and a special thanks to Dr. Bonalumi for her professionalism and "double" empathy, towards people and animals.
Highly qualified clinic, very professional staff. Dr. Roberta Bonalumi treated me very well, and I finally have a direct contact. I highly recommend her.
I wanted to thank Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, who has been treating my shibina for about 5 years with professionalism, expertise, and empathy. I couldn't have asked for anything better!

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is a truly exceptional veterinarian: competent, meticulous, kind, and always available. She takes great care of our seven Chihuahuas with great care and professionalism, demonstrating a passion for her work and genuine compassion for animals. We trust her with complete peace of mind and couldn't be more satisfied. Highly recommended!

For many years, I frequented the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic with my many pugs, both adopted and fostered.
My point of contact, and theirs, has always been Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, an expert in brachycephalic breeds, especially for surgery and anesthesia.
Despite the breed's complexities, everything has always gone smoothly, even in objectively difficult cases (I remember my Gina). To this, I must add that we are always welcomed with great kindness and empathy towards the dogs and their owners. They are available even for after-hours phone calls (late at night), and even during holidays! I would highly recommend the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic for its professionalism and attention to every aspect (including financial matters), and above all, Dr. Bonalumi for her presence, expertise, and approach.
The Clinic is now easily accessible from all parts of Milan, via the BLUE metro line.
I've trusted Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for years for my four-legged friend. She's empathetic towards our furry friends and very professional, always kind and helpful. Thank you so much.
Dr. Roberta is an excellent professional. She's been treating my dog ​​for many years. I trust her and her entire staff implicitly.
A serious, helpful clinic, always ready to care for our animals. Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is exceptional.
Dr. Roberta is very professional and does her work with dedication and passion!

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is simply exceptional. A highly trained, competent, and constantly updated professional, she can handle any situation with great confidence and serenity. But what makes her truly special is her human side: she treats every animal as if it were her own and manages to instill peace in even the most difficult of times.
Her availability is truly extraordinary: she is always present, available, and ready to help, with infinite kindness and patience. She never fails to offer advice, a word of comfort, or concrete support, demonstrating a dedication to her work that is truly rare these days.
Entrusting your animals to her means putting them in the best possible hands, and I have been entrusting my poodle, Lola, to her for years with my eyes closed. Professionalism, expertise, humanity, passion, and a willingness to help that goes far beyond the call of duty. An extraordinary veterinarian whom I recommend without the slightest hesitation. Five stars are not enough: she deserves ten! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

For almost 10 years, I've been bringing my dog ​​Bianca, a Bichon Frise, to the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic, and I couldn't be more satisfied.
Dr. Roberta Bonalumi in particular has become a true go-to: extremely competent, always up-to-date, and incredibly attentive to every detail.
What really makes the difference, however, is her human side: she's a super loving professional, capable of putting both animals and owners at ease. Bianca adores her, and that means a lot to me.
Every visit is characterized by great availability, a listening ear, and always timely and targeted advice. Her passion for her work and genuine care for animals are clearly evident.
A highly recommended referral, and a special thank you to Roberta from Bianca!

On the advice of friends, when my first dog arrived, I entrusted myself to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi.
I immediately found her to be very knowledgeable, empathetic, clear in her explanations, and very patient.
She immediately advised me on everything I needed to do to best raise him.
For any problem or question, she always answered the phone and recommended the appropriate treatment, always available, even outside of working hours.
For an emergency, she waited for me at the clinic very late at night.
For vaccinations and visits, she also comes to my home, so the dog remains in his natural habitat, which is a great convenience when you don't have a car.
Furthermore, the doctor also performs surgical procedures if necessary.
My beautiful dog is now 7 years old, and I know he is being cared for me meticulously and attentively. I am very satisfied.

Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is not only professional and competent, but above all attentive, prompt, and precise. She puts the animal's well-being first, an approach that is becoming increasingly rare in this field. Her expertise, combined with her experience, makes her a doctor who anticipates problems, ensuring a healthy, happy, and peaceful life for all her patients. Her helpfulness has also made me, the owner, her patient, as she has a remarkable understanding of the owner-animal bond and is always ready to reassure even apprehensive and worried owners. After meeting Roberta, there is no other doctor I would entrust my dog ​​to.

I've been bringing my cats to this clinic for eight years now, always cared for by Dr. Roberta Bonalumi with such professionalism, dedication, and love for my animals.
A special thanks to Bianca, who, thanks to her care, is able to live with her cat cough.

I highly recommend Dr. Roberta Bonalumi. She treats my cat with impeccable expertise and extraordinary kindness. She knows how to put him at ease, and is always very clear and available.

For me, she's an absolute reference. Highly recommended.

I've often brought my dogs to the clinic, where they've always been treated with professionalism, efficiency, and kindness (which is never a given these days!). Special mention goes to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for her professionalism and instinctive empathy for anxious dogs and owners! Always up-to-date, available, and ready to offer valuable advice. Absolute peace of mind, always accompanied by a smile! Thank you to her and the entire clinic team!

Care, expertise, and the utmost professionalism distinguish the clinic, but above all, the sensitivity and skill of Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has given us complete peace of mind and confidence in the care and love she provides for our kittens.

Thank you, thank you, thank you

I've known Dr. Bonalumi for years and I can't imagine a better veterinarian. She's accurate in her diagnoses, excellent in her treatments and surgery, always available and available over the phone to assist in critical situations, and very humane and kind. She's also available to patiently listen to pet owners' concerns. A true professional!

Having met Roberta Bonalumi for me was a real stroke of luck on all fronts both for me and for my cats, thanks to her who lived 18 and 20 years supporting me too because it was not easy having a diabetic cat and having him live 20 years only thanks to her strength and great experience with her constant presence on holidays and weekdays unique.
Dr. Bonalumi is extremely patient and affectionate with furry friends. My experience with her has been positive, and she's given me helpful advice for my dog's problems.

Highly recommended clinic. In my opinion, Dr. Roberta Bonalumi is one of a kind! She does her work with passion and love for animals.
Thank you for what you do!

I've known Dr. Roberta Bonalumi for years now, and I've entrusted my furry friend Nala to her loving care since she was a puppy. Roberta has proven to be not only a very kind person, but also a fundamental support system for us—always super helpful and very clear in her explanations. But above all, what I consider fundamental to her profession is the love, patience, and gentleness she shows her furry patients! In conclusion, my rating: 10 with honors!

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic, especially Dr. Roberta Bonalumi. Our dog Elfo has been her patient since we adopted him 5 years ago. She is fantastic, very empathetic, and incredibly patient, especially with a dog like mine, who is a bit temperamental and aggressive, even though he's small. Roberta has solved many problems, from eye ulcers to gastroenteritis. I also recently took my dog ​​to an emergency clinic for a foxtail in his ear, and with her patience and care, she managed to extract it flawlessly. Thanks also to her wonderful assistant. Thank you for always being there, Roberta!
I want to thank the Lorenteggio Clinic and especially Roberta for the love, honesty, and professionalism with which she always cares for my dog. Finally, someone serious and competent. Thank you!

Our experience with Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has been beyond positive; her helpfulness and professionalism are second to none. When needed, she has always done her utmost to ensure the health of our little four-legged friends.
She has cared for a pug for us and currently a French bulldog.
Highly recommended veterinarian.
Giuseppe and Lorena
Excellent clinic Thanks to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi who treats our dogs with love, professionalism and passion, solving any type of emergency

Thanks to a friend, I was fortunate enough to discover this veterinary practice a couple of years ago. Specifically, for my furry friends, I turned to Dr. Roberta Bonalumi. She is a top-notch professional, ALWAYS available, helpful, and extremely knowledgeable. Her rates are more than fair. I can't thank her enough for everything she has done and continues to do for my little pet. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

I would like to thank all the staff at the veterinary clinic, especially Dr. Roberta Bonalumi, who has always been attentive, competent, and caring towards my dogs. Her helpfulness, kindness, and the love with which she carries out her work truly make a difference. I recommend this doctor to anyone seeking professionalism and genuine care for animals.

I have a 12-year-old dog and a 14-year-old cat, and between my hypochondria and their pranks, Dr. Roberta Bonalumi has supported us for years with great passion and expertise and, above all, enormous availability. Highly recommended ❤️

When more than one vet thought my dog ​​was beyond saving, and even the emergency room told me he wouldn't make it to the next day, I was in a panic. Suddenly, I got a call from a relative telling me to bring my dog ​​to the Lorenteggio clinic the next day. I arrived, and was greeted with a warmth I'd never seen before. Roberta's first words were "Don't worry, I'll save your dog."
And so it was. 💝 No one had realized that my dog ​​had ADB, a dispersing protein. He was skin and bones, vomiting, and crawling on the floor. I wanted to report the fact that a few weeks ago, our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Bibi, sadly passed away. She was being treated by Dr. Roberta Bonalumi. Despite our insistence for a more thorough checkup or examination, she completely misdiagnosed the fluid that was causing excessive abdominal swelling, mistaking it for "gas in the belly." I should point out that Bibi had a heart condition and was strictly following the treatments prescribed by Bonalumi and the ultrasound specialist (especially for the heart and abdomen), Dr. Tutino. However, in the 5 days prior to her death, despite having been examined by both of them and despite our insistence, as I mentioned earlier, for them, but especially for Bonalumi, the dog only had gas in her belly. On Monday afternoon around 4:30 PM, Bonalumi returned to our house precisely because Bibi always had a swollen belly, and on that occasion too, her diagnosis was gas in the belly, and she was given Buscopan. By the evening, Bibi was breathing heavily and had stopped walking, so we called Bonalumi again, who superficially advised us to go to the Gran Sasso clinic in Milan if we wanted. Otherwise, she said, we could wait until the next morning and take her to her. We rushed to the clinic, where the doctors did everything they could to save her, as her abdomen and lungs were completely filled with fluid. They even asked us why we hadn't gone there sooner. Of course, I explained to the doctors everything that had happened to Bibi over the past five days. Bibi could have been saved, but Bonalumi took the situation lightly. Furthermore, about two years ago, our Jack Russell was very ill. Bonalumi was taking care of him, and she asked me to take him to her clinic for a check-up, but an ultrasound was absolutely necessary, and her ultrasound would have arrived at 2:30 PM. He lay there feeling unwell from 9:00 AM until about 2:45 PM, when the ultrasound arrived. Unfortunately, he died due to intestinal complications. In that case, I didn't blame Bonalumi, but given all those hours of waiting, she could have sent me and the dog to have the ultrasound somewhere else! Given both sad situations, I'm led to believe that Bonalumi's carelessness caused serious damage, and in the more recent case, Bibi could have been saved.
Thanks Gabriele!

I contacted the clinic early Saturday morning and was told to take her for an abdominal ultrasound. The results led the medical director to inform us that the cat (with heart disease) was at risk of dying from a pyometra. The surgery was scheduled for Sunday noon, with the surgeon and anesthesiologist adjusting the anesthesia to the cat's condition. On Tuesday, she was given back to us. Thank you for the attention and care you gave Turchese, for the medical director's expertise, and for the patience you showed her owners. I have nothing to say about the clinical management of my cat, who was unfortunately elderly and died in the clinic: in this respect, the procedure was adequate.
Unfortunately, however, from a humane perspective, the experience was very disappointing. For a single cremation of a cat weighing less than 6 kg, we were charged €500. When we asked if it was possible to use another company, given the very high fee, we were told that it was mandatory to go through them, and they gave us a €50 discount.
Understandably distressed by the situation, we accepted and paid. The next day, upon contacting another cremation company, we discovered that there is no such obligation and that the choice should be free.
We then contacted the clinic again to find out if the cat had already been collected. When we learned that it was still there, we asked to use another facility, with a corresponding cancellation of the invoice. Our request was denied.
It's a great shame, because we've always had a good experience in the past. This time, however, we felt a lack of sensitivity and a lot of attention to the financial aspect at an extremely delicate time for those who lose an animal.
Those who do this work should do it, first and foremost, with empathy and respect.

I brought my cat to this clinic in November for a swollen lip. They followed her for about three months, but without reaching a correct diagnosis. After two months, a biopsy was performed, which, as it turned out, was too superficial and on too small a sample, making the tests unreliable and leading to an incorrect diagnosis.
Based on that diagnosis, my cat underwent a further month of treatment that later proved to be unnecessary and harmful, causing her further suffering. After three months of visits and a worsening clinical condition, I was offered invasive surgery. At that point, precisely because the situation continued to worsen despite the long treatment I had already undergone with them, I decided to seek a second opinion from an oncologist at another clinic.
The oncologist deemed it necessary to perform a second biopsy, which revealed terminal large cell lymphoma. This means that the initial diagnosis from the Lorenteggio Veterinary Clinic and the treatments administered up to that point were incorrect, resulting in unnecessary suffering for my cat.
After refusing chemotherapy, I returned to them, simply asking for palliative cortisone therapy and to assist me, when the time came, in deciding on euthanasia, so that I could manage everything in a more convenient facility. They emailed me that they didn't intend to pursue the case and that I should contact the person who had provided the second opinion. I then called to explain the situation and ask for support again, but I encountered a wall. So I went in person and, despite being granted permission to see the cat again a week later, they still refused to give me the cortisone immediately, even though it would relieve her pain.
At that point, I contacted another veterinarian, who prescribed the cortisone without any problem.

My final impression is this: goodwill, but insufficient expertise in a serious case, and above all, no real accountability after mistakes that cost my cat months of suffering, not to mention the expense. Mistakes can happen, but the way they were handled afterward, where I showed complete understanding, no accusations, and simply asked for assistance, was even worse. The negative review is primarily for this reason and goes far beyond the diagnostic error.
